314:         # Is the track length at least 25% of the song?
315:         if track_len - 1 > 0.25 * (reference_beats.shape[0] - 2):
316:             goto_criteria = 1
317:             start_beat = incorrect_beats[track_start]
318:             end_beat = incorrect_beats[track_start + 1]
319:             track = beat_error[start_beat : end_beat + 1]
320:     # If we have a track
321:     if goto_criteria:
322:         # Are mean and std of the track less than the required thresholds?
323:         if np.mean(np.abs(track)) < goto_mu and np.std(track, ddof=1) < goto_sigma:
324:             goto_criteria = 3
325:     # If all criteria are met, score is 100%!
326:     return 1.0 * (goto_criteria == 3)
327: 
328: 
329: def p_score(reference_beats, estimated_beats, p_score_threshold=0.2):
330:     """Get McKinney's P-score.
331:     Based on the autocorrelation of the reference and estimated beats
332: 
333:     Examples
334:     --------
335:     >>> reference_beats = mir_eval.io.load_events('reference.txt')
336:     >>> reference_beats = mir_eval.beat.trim_beats(reference_beats)
337:     >>> estimated_beats = mir_eval.io.load_events('estimated.txt')
338:     >>> estimated_beats = mir_eval.beat.trim_beats(estimated_beats)
339:     >>> p_score = mir_eval.beat.p_score(reference_beats, estimated_beats)
340: 
341:     Parameters
342:     ----------
343:     reference_beats : np.ndarray
344:         reference beat times, in seconds
345:     estimated_beats : np.ndarray
346:         query beat times, in seconds
347:     p_score_threshold : float
348:         Window size will be
349:         ``p_score_threshold*np.median(inter_annotation_intervals)``,
350:         (Default value = 0.2)
351: 
352:     Returns
353:     -------
354:     correlation : float
355:         McKinney's P-score
356: 
357:     """
358:     validate(reference_beats, estimated_beats)
359:     # Warn when only one beat is provided for either estimated or reference,
360:     # report a warning
361:     if reference_beats.size == 1:
362:         warnings.warn(
363:             "Only one reference beat was provided, so beat intervals"
364:             " cannot be computed."
365:         )
366:     if estimated_beats.size == 1:
367:         warnings.warn(
368:             "Only one estimated beat was provided, so beat intervals"
369:             " cannot be computed."
370:         )
371:     # When estimated or reference beats have <= 1 beats, can't compute the
372:     # metric, so return 0
373:     if estimated_beats.size <= 1 or reference_beats.size <= 1:
374:         return 0.0
375:     # Quantize beats to 10ms
376:     sampling_rate = int(1.0 / 0.010)
377:     # Shift beats so that the minimum in either sequence is zero
378:     offset = min(estimated_beats.min(), reference_beats.min())
379:     estimated_beats = np.array(estimated_beats - offset)
380:     reference_beats = np.array(reference_beats - offset)
381:     # Get the largest time index
382:     end_point = np.int64(
383:         np.ceil(np.max([np.max(estimated_beats), np.max(reference_beats)]))
384:     )
385:     # Make impulse trains with impulses at beat locations
386:     reference_train = np.zeros(end_point * sampling_rate + 1)
387:     beat_indices = np.ceil(reference_beats * sampling_rate).astype(np.int64)
388:     reference_train[beat_indices] = 1.0
389:     estimated_train = np.zeros(end_point * sampling_rate + 1)
390:     beat_indices = np.ceil(estimated_beats * sampling_rate).astype(np.int64)
391:     estimated_train[beat_indices] = 1.0
392:     # Window size to take the correlation over
393:     # defined as .2*median(inter-annotation-intervals)
394:     annotation_intervals = np.diff(np.flatnonzero(reference_train))
395:     win_size = int(np.round(p_score_threshold * np.median(annotation_intervals)))
396:     # Get full correlation
397:     train_correlation = np.correlate(reference_train, estimated_train, "full")
398:     # Get the middle element - note we are rounding down on purpose here
399:     middle_lag = train_correlation.shape[0] // 2
400:     # Truncate to only valid lags (those corresponding to the window)
401:     start = middle_lag - win_size
402:     end = middle_lag + win_size + 1
403:     train_correlation = train_correlation[start:end]
404:     # Compute and return the P-score
405:     n_beats = np.max([estimated_beats.shape[0], reference_beats.shape[0]])
406:     return np.sum(train_correlation) / n_beats
407: 
408: 
409: def continuity(
410:     reference_beats,
411:     estimated_beats,
412:     continuity_phase_threshold=0.175,
413:     continuity_period_threshold=0.175,
414: ):
415:     """Get metrics based on how much of the estimated beat sequence is
416:     continually correct.
417: 
418:     Examples
419:     --------
420:     >>> reference_beats = mir_eval.io.load_events('reference.txt')
421:     >>> reference_beats = mir_eval.beat.trim_beats(reference_beats)
422:     >>> estimated_beats = mir_eval.io.load_events('estimated.txt')
423:     >>> estimated_beats = mir_eval.beat.trim_beats(estimated_beats)
424:     >>> CMLc, CMLt, AMLc, AMLt = mir_eval.beat.continuity(reference_beats,
425:                                                           estimated_beats)
426: 
427:     Parameters
428:     ----------
429:     reference_beats : np.ndarray
430:         reference beat times, in seconds
431:     estimated_beats : np.ndarray
432:         query beat times, in seconds
433:     continuity_phase_threshold : float
434:         Allowable ratio of how far is the estimated beat
435:         can be from the reference beat
436:         (Default value = 0.175)
437:     continuity_period_threshold : float
438:         Allowable distance between the inter-beat-interval
439:         and the inter-annotation-interval
440:         (Default value = 0.175)
441: 
442:     Returns
443:     -------
444:     CMLc : float
445:         Correct metric level, continuous accuracy
446:     CMLt : float
447:         Correct metric level, total accuracy (continuity not required)
448:     AMLc : float
449:         Any metric level, continuous accuracy
450:     AMLt : float
451:         Any metric level, total accuracy (continuity not required)
452:     """
453:     validate(reference_beats, estimated_beats)
454:     # Warn when only one beat is provided for either estimated or reference,
455:     # report a warning
456:     if reference_beats.size == 1:
457:         warnings.warn(
458:             "Only one reference beat was provided, so beat intervals"
459:             " cannot be computed."
460:         )
461:     if estimated_beats.size == 1:
462:         warnings.warn(
463:             "Only one estimated beat was provided, so beat intervals"
464:             " cannot be computed."
465:         )
466:     # When estimated or reference beats have <= 1 beats, can't compute the
467:     # metric, so return 0
468:     if estimated_beats.size <= 1 or reference_beats.size <= 1:
469:         return 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
